picks.title: #1533 -  What It Means to Have Sadhguru as One's Guru
picks.summary:
Is the Guru's grace limited by time and space? What does it mean to truly sit with Sadhguru? How can one make use of the Guru for one’s growth and liberation? Sadhguru speaks about the significance of a Guru in a seeker’s life and answers some of the most common questions that have concerned seekers for millennia.

picks.showTitle: Indian Kids- Spiritual Stories of Ancient India
picks.title: Bhagvad Gita Chapter 9
picks.summary: Now in Chapter Nine the glories of the Lord will be delineated. For those who understand that Krishna is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the pure and transcendental Personality, these chapters will be very beneficial. Here Lord has clearly explained his different energies to establish devotion in firm conviction. Here the word Rajvidhya refers to pure devotional service which consist of 9 different activities in relation to Supreme God Vishnu viz hearing, chanting, remembering, serving, worshipping, praying, obeying, maintaining friendship and surrendering everything.
picks.reason: Explains devotional service and Krishna's energies from Bhagavad Gita Chapter 9.

picks.showTitle: Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna - Swami Sarvapriyananda
picks.title: Gospel | Chapter 7: Dec 14, 1882 (Part 4) | Swami Sarvapriyananda
picks.summary: Swami Sarvapriyananda reads and discusses the Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna. The Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna is an English translation of the Bengali spiritual text Sri Sri Ramakrishna Kathamrita by Swami Nikhilananda. The text records conversations of Ramakrishna with his disciples, devotees and visitors, recorded by Mahendranath Gupta, who wrote the book under the pseudonym of "M."This session was recorded on Jan 17, 2023.🙏 Please Support the Vedanta Society of New Yorkhttp://www.vedantany.org/donate🌐 Please Visit UsWebsite: https://vedantany.orgApple & Spotify Podcasts: https://www.vedantany.org/
picks.reason: Same as episode 7, detailed exploration of Ramakrishna's teachings.
